item.title: From Bates County Clerk, Jami Page regarding Senior Tax Credit
item.description: We will be accepting applications for the Senior Tax Credit from Feb 2, 2026 to April 27, 2026.If you applied for the credit last year, you will be receiving a new application in the mail. The application needs to be filled out yearly.If you did not apply for the credit last year, and would like to apply this year, please stop by our office and pick up an application. If you would like one mailed or emailed to you, please email clerk@batescountymo.gov.

item.title: Butler Urgent Care art contest winners announced
item.description: We apologize for the delay in art results! They are in! Given that Doc Henderson knows half the entrants- she recused herself from judging to make it fair. There were 3 impartial judges, all who judged based on the form attached and anonymously. All three are artists, one a professional, and one an art teacher- one from out of state and one from out of the county to make it as fair and balanced as possible because judging art is HARD. Points were added and prizes awarded by total points scored.

item.title: Slight cold front headed our way tonight
item.description: A cold front sags through tonight.It has a wintry mix with it. Temps should be around but hopefully just above freezing, so - watch out for this around 8-10pm tonight.-GreG@660weather

item.description: Debbie Lin Goth was born to Leonard “Lennie” Aloysius Goth and Martha Jane (Bellinghausen) Goth on August 20, 1956, in Appleton City, MO. item.title: Obituary - Sharon Garrett
item.description: Sharon Kathleen Garrett was born in St. Louis, Missouri March 30, 1946, the daughter of Edward Alvah and Mildred Fern (Meesey) Murphy. She departed this life in Appleton City, Missouri January 8, 2026 at 79 years of age.A Celebration of Life will be held at a later date. Courtesy Hill & Son Funeral Home.
